title: One Mountain, Many Names
logline: Pilgrims of different faiths climb through the night to the same summit. Each calls it by a different name, and at dawn they all stand in front of the same stone, wind and light.

object.note: Object 1 (identity not chosen) could enter only if something ordinary genuinely passes to Chathura on the night climb or at the summit, for example something offered by a pilgrim. Never staged.

thread_out.thread: The dawn reached at the summit carries into the next film's question: when does 'morning' actually begin, and who decides it?

requirements: A single place genuinely named differently by different communities
Night and dawn access; safe filming on steps
Pilgrims willing to speak about the names they use

suggestions.name: Sri Pada / Adam's Peak (Samanalakanda, Sivanolipatha Malai)
suggestions.why: One mountain held sacred by Buddhist, Hindu, Muslim and Christian pilgrims, each with its own name and story.
suggestions.season_notes: Pilgrim season, roughly Unduvap Poya (Dec) to Vesak (May)
suggestions.access_notes: Crowded on poya weekends; Hatton (Nallathanni) and Ratnapura (Palabaddala) routes
suggestions.verify: Access, permissions and current conditions are unverified.
